g.text: Guarded policy: p = min(max(b, s), nextcap(b))

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596c7b

g.text: b = base; s = scoped; nextcap = smallest 32/64/128 ≥ b, else ∞.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596c7b

g.text: The policy exactly preserves base decisions at these caps, including existing mistakes, and never lowers a base point estimate.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a44635

g.text: Regressions: retained 32-case stress MAE 15.52 → 15.67 / MAPE 13.42% → 13.78%; new four-case signed dual arithmetic MAE 18.04 → 20.63.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596c7b

g.text: First 40-case test is consumed development for the later policy. Separate cohorts; no learning curve. Base remains the default.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596c7b

g.text: Synthetic circuit evidence only; no calibrated safety, application-transfer, timing, power or full-CPU guarantee.
